/* DEMOGRAPHICS */

SELECT DISTINCT A.CustomerID,
                A.RelationshipStartDate,
                A.Email,
                A.MobileNumber,
                CONCAT(A.AddressLine1, ', ',
                    --   AddressLine2, ', ',  
                    --   AddressLine3, ', ', 
                       A.City, ', ', 
                       A.Province, ', ', 
                       A.ZipCode, ', ', 
                       A.Country) AS FullAddress,
                B.GenerationalCohortName,
                A.Gender,
                A.MaritalStatus,
                A.Occupation,
                A.DateOfBirth,
                A.LastKYCDate,
                A.ATMEnrollmentIndicator,
                A.OnlineBankingEnrollmentIndicator,
                A.MobileBankingEnrollmentIndicator,
                A.DataPrivacyConsent
FROM DW.DimCustomer A
LEFT JOIN DW.DimGenerationalCohort B
    ON B.GenerationalCohortSK = A.GenerationalCohortSK 
WHERE CustomerID IN ('R00327988', 'R00856204')




/* MEASURES */

-- Deposit Balance
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance
WHERE AccountSK IN (    SELECT DISTINCT AccountSK
                        FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount
                        WHERE CustomerID = 'R00327988' AND BusinessDateSK = '20230209')
ORDER BY BusinessDateSK DESC

select top 5 *
from DW.DimAccountHolderType

-- MTD ADB
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD
WHERE AccountSK IN (    SELECT DISTINCT AccountSK
                        FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount
                        WHERE CustomerID = 'R00327988' AND BusinessDateSK = '20230601')

-- YTD ADB
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD
WHERE AccountSK IN (    SELECT DISTINCT AccountSK
                        FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount
                        WHERE CustomerID = 'R00327988' AND BusinessDateSK = '20230601')
                        
-- Total Relationship Balance
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactTotalRelationshipBalance
WHERE CustomerID = 'R00327988' AND BusinessDateSK = '20230601'

-- Trust Fund Value
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactTrustFundValue
WHERE AccountSK IN (    SELECT DISTINCT AccountSK
                        FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount
                        WHERE CustomerID = 'R00327988' AND BusinessDateSK = '20230601')

-- Treasury Investment Value
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment
WHERE AccountSK IN (    SELECT DISTINCT AccountSK
                        FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount
                        WHERE CustomerID = 'R00327988' AND BusinessDateSK = '20230601')

-- Due for the Month
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance
WHERE AccountSK IN (    SELECT DISTINCT AccountSK
                        FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount
                        WHERE CustomerID = 'R00327988' AND BusinessDateSK = '20230601')

-- Loans Relationship Exposure
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure
WHERE AccountSK IN (    SELECT DISTINCT AccountSK
                        FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount
                        WHERE CustomerID = 'R00327988' AND BusinessDateSK = '20230601')

-- Loan Credit Limit
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactLoansCreditLimit
WHERE AccountSK IN (    SELECT DISTINCT AccountSK
                        FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount
                        WHERE CustomerID = 'R00327988' AND BusinessDateSK = '20230601')

-- TOTAL Relationship Exposure
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactTotalRelationshipExposure
WHERE CustomerID = 'R00327988' AND BusinessDateSK = '20230601'



/* ACCOUNTS */

SELECT DISTINCT *, B.BalanceAmountFull
FROM DW.DimAccount A
LEFT JOIN DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance B
    ON A.AccountID = B.AccountID
WHERE A.AccountID IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT AccountID
        FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount 
        LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch
            ON DW.DimCustomerAccount.BranchSK = DW.DimBranch.BranchSK
        WHERE CustomerID = 'R00327988')
    AND A.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' -- Deposit accounts only
    AND A.BranchSK = '12' -- Branch 1012 (SM Mall of Asia)
    AND B.BusinessDateSK = '20230209'


Select top 10 ddc.customerid
from dw.dimcustomer ddc
left join dw.dimcustomeraccount dca
        on ddc.customersk = dca.customersk
left join dw.dimbranch ddb
        on ddb.branchsk = dca.branchsk
where ddb.branchid = '1012'
 -- and ddb.branchid <> ''
